ModMetaData.name: RimWorld AI Bridge
ModMetaData.author: consigcody94
ModMetaData.description: Exposes a local HTTP + JSON API (127.0.0.1:18800 by default) so AI agents (Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, any MCP client) can observe the colony and issue orders: draft, move, attack, work priorities, designations, building, zones, bills, research, saves, screenshots. All game access is marshalled onto the main thread. Settings: Options > Mod Settings > RimWorld AI Bridge.
